title: A path's line picks its brush by its stroke, with Browse brushes and Edit brush beside it
goal: Choosing what a drawn line is painted with shows each brush as a little sample stroke, the way the Brush tool's chooser already does, instead of a list of words, and offers Browse brushes and Edit brush next to it as the drawing mock shows.
notes: Follow-up from a-vector-path-s-line-can-be-painted-with-a-brush (2026-10-31), which shipped the row as a word dropdown (PathBrushSettings.swift) because the tile chooser (BrushChooser.swift: BrushChooserButton/BrushChooserGrid) is tied to the armed brush and a second popover needs queue/bin/focus-drill.sh with the person away. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/draw.html Stroke group (Brush picker, Size, Flow, Color, Browse brushes, Edit brush) and vector-wt.html step 9 (Library scope Brushes). The user asked on 2026-10-24 that brushes be picked from tiles, not a dropdown. Edit brush depends on a brush editor that does not exist yet (brush-editor.html); it can open the panel's full Brush settings for that medium until then.
acceptance: The Brush row under a path's Line shows the picked brush as its sample stroke and opens the same tiles the Brush tool uses, with Plain among them
Browse brushes opens the Library on its Brushes shelf, and dropping or clicking a brush there restyles the picked lines
A walk with no flags picks a line's brush by clicking a tile, with real window pictures in the audit, and focus-drill reads clean for the new popover

log.note: triage 2026-10-31: the unit word on a brushed line (Thickness px) against the Brush tool's Size pt is filed on its own as brush-sizes-use-the-same-unit-word-as-every-othe; whichever lands second keeps the other's word.
